descriptions.disk-local: Reads space usage for each supported local filesystem and compares it with warning and critical thresholds. Writable filesystems determine attention; mounts that share capacity are identified. It does not check inodes, quotas or network filesystems.
descriptions.package-updates: Simulates pending APT upgrades using the server’s locally cached package lists. It does not install packages or refresh lists, and does not verify repository freshness or security-update counts.
descriptions.reboot-required: Checks whether packages have left a reboot-required marker. A marker raises a warning; no marker passes this limited check, without proving that every possible reason for rebooting is absent.
descriptions.fstrim-status: Observes fstrim.timer and its service result. Successful completion evidence survives a server reboot, and a weekly schedule is assessed against its expected run rather than the age of every reading. It does not prove that device space was physically reclaimed.

disk-local: Set warning and critical thresholds. They apply to supported local filesystems on servers using the defaults.
Open a server from Dashboard to override its thresholds or observation interval.
package-updates: Keep local APT package lists updated through your existing server administration. This skill does not refresh them.
Choose whether the simulated upgrade may include new dependencies.
Open a server from Dashboard to override its settings.
reboot-required: The agent reads the package reboot marker; no separate server setup is required.
Open a server from Dashboard to override its observation timing.
fstrim-status: Enable the server’s existing fstrim.timer through your normal server administration.
TinyWarden observes the timer; it does not run trim or alter the schedule.
Open a server from Dashboard to override observation timing.

account.title: My account
account.help: Your profile and the ways you sign in. Your role and server access are set by an admin.
account.profileHelp: Your role and server access are managed by an administrator.
account.emailHelp: Optional. Adding an address does not subscribe you to monitoring notifications.
account.emailRecoveryHelp: Verify your email to enable recovery of your local password. An administrator can still reset it.
account.signInHelp: Passwords and recovery for connected accounts are managed by your identity provider.
account.linkHelp: Sign in locally within the last 15 minutes, then confirm your identity with the provider. Accounts are never connected automatically by matching email.
account.unlinkHelp: Disconnecting removes provider-granted groups and signs out provider sessions. A usable local password is required.
account.providerGroupsHelp: These memberships are synchronized on sign-in and expire after one hour. Manual group assignments are managed separately.
account.recentLogin: Sign in locally again before connecting an account.
account.localRequired: Disconnecting requires a usable local password. In OIDC mode, only local Admins can use that fallback.
account.conflict: Your account changed. Reload it before saving.
account.invalid: Check the values and try again.
account.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. Reload before trying again.
account.usernameHelp: Your username is used for local sign-in.

oidc.title: Sign-in
oidc.help: Choose how people sign in to TinyWarden.
oidc.label: Button label
oidc.issuerHelp: Use the exact HTTPS issuer from the provider’s discovery document, including its trailing slash if present.
oidc.secretHelp: Set TW_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET in the app environment and restart the web service. The secret is never displayed here.
oidc.callbackHelp: Register this exact URL in your provider. Use Authorization Code, a confidential client and an RS256 signing key.
oidc.groupsClaimHelp: The claim containing a list of group names, usually groups.
oidc.mappingsHelp: Map provider group names to existing TinyWarden groups. These mappings grant server access; they never change Admin or User roles.
oidc.noGroups: Create groups in Users & groups before adding mappings.
oidc.rulesHelp: Provider sign-ins last up to one hour, with a 30-minute idle limit. Provider group access also expires after one hour. Disabling a user here revokes access immediately. Sign out ends your TinyWarden session; it does not end your provider session.
oidc.fallbackHelp: While the provider is in use, local Users can’t sign in with a password. At least one enabled local Admin with a changed initial password is required, so you can still get in if the provider is down.
oidc.immutable: Issuer and Client ID cannot change while accounts are connected. Disconnect those accounts first.
oidc.fallbackRequired: Keep an enabled local Admin with a usable password before enabling this provider.
oidc.signInFailed: Provider sign-in failed. Start again or contact an administrator. Local Admins can use password sign-in.
oidc.unavailable: Provider sign-in is unavailable. Try again or contact an administrator. Local Admins can use password sign-in.
oidc.methodHelp: Choose one. It decides who creates accounts and where people enter their password.
oidc.localHelp: Admins create every account in Users & groups. People sign in here with a username and password.
oidc.oidcHelp: People sign in through authentik, Keycloak or another OpenID Connect provider. Groups can come from the provider.
oidc.pendingOidc: Not switched yet. Local accounts stay in use until you save.
oidc.pendingOidcHelp: After saving, local Users can no longer sign in with a password. Local Admins keep password sign-in as a fallback.
oidc.pendingLocal: Not switched yet. The provider stays in use until you save.
oidc.pendingLocalHelp: After saving, provider sign-in stops and its settings are hidden. People who signed in through {provider} need a local password from an Admin.
oidc.providerHelp: The OpenID Connect provider people sign in with.
oidc.provisioningHelp: Anyone allowed to sign in by your provider can use TinyWarden. Their account is created automatically as a User. Group mappings and server assignments decide what they can view.
oidc.fieldsRequired: Add the issuer URL and client ID first.
oidc.loginFallback: Use your identity provider to sign in. Password sign-in is available to local Admins only.

verify.title: Verify your email address
verify.help: Confirm this address for your TinyWarden account. Local accounts can then use it for password recovery.
verify.expiry: This link expires in 1 hour and can be used once. A newer verification link replaces this one.
verify.ignore: If you did not request this, ignore this email. Your address will remain unverified.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.title: Reset your password
reset.help: A password reset was requested for your TinyWarden account. Choose a new password using the link below.
reset.expiry: This link expires in 30 minutes and can be used once. A newer reset link replaces this one.
reset.ignore: If you did not request this, ignore this email. Your password will stay unchanged.

reset_notice.subject: Your password was changed
reset_notice.title: Your password was changed
reset_notice.help: The local password for your TinyWarden account was changed. All existing sessions have been signed out.
reset_notice.expiry: Use your new password to sign in.
reset_notice.ignore: If you did not make this change, contact your administrator immediately.

accountEmail.verifyHelp: Confirm your current password to send a verification link to your saved email address.
accountEmail.verifySsoHelp: A recent provider sign-in is required to verify your email. This does not enable local password recovery.
accountEmail.queuedHelp: Check your inbox; delivery may take a minute. Only the newest link will work.
accountEmail.saveFirst: Save your email before requesting verification.
accountEmail.disabled: Account email is not configured. Contact your administrator.
accountEmail.ready: Your verified email can recover your local password.
accountEmail.ssoRecovery: Recover access through your identity provider. Email verification does not add a local password.
accountEmail.recentSignIn: Sign in with your identity provider again, then request verification.
accountEmail.limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
accountEmail.invalid: Check the information and try again.
accountEmail.unavailable: The request could not be confirmed. Wait a minute before trying again.
accountEmail.forgotHelp: Enter your username to request a reset link for your local password.
accountEmail.forgotSent: If an enabled local account with that username has a verified email, a reset link will be sent. Check your inbox.
accountEmail.forgotScope: For provider-only accounts, use your identity provider’s recovery. If you have no verified email, ask an administrator to reset your local password.
accountEmail.resetHelp: Choose a new local password. Changing it signs out all existing sessions.
accountEmail.resetSuccess: Your password has been changed. Sign in again with your new password.
accountEmail.verifyLandingHelp: Confirm that this email address belongs to you. Opening this page does not verify it.
accountEmail.verified: Your email is verified. Local password recovery is now available if your account has a local password.
accountEmail.missingLink: Open the link from your email to continue.
accountEmail.invalidLink: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link.

resources.loadError: Resource discovery could not be loaded.
resources.limitHelp: The selection limit is reached. Remove a target before adding another.
resources.selectionHelp: Selections apply only to this server. Newly discovered resources are never selected automatically.
resources.demoDescription: A continuous resource discovered on this server.
resources.snapshotHelp: Discovery may change while you edit. If saving reports a conflict, discard the draft and select again from a fresh reading.

fleetManagement.title: Fleet
fleetManagement.selectionLimit: Select up to 100 servers at a time.
fleetManagement.name: Name
fleetManagement.operationHelp: Each server is checked separately. Successful changes are kept when another server needs attention.
fleetManagement.purge_pending_help: Deletion continues in the background. This server cannot reconnect.
fleetManagement.notesHelp: Only Admins can see owner notes.
fleetManagement.tagsHelp: Separate tags with commas. Up to 20 tags, 64 characters each.
fleetManagement.groupsHelp: Fleet groups organize servers. They do not grant access.
fleetManagement.deleteGroupHelp: Servers stay in the fleet and keep their data.
fleetManagement.metadataHelp: Update this server’s name, notes and organization.
fleetManagement.membershipHelp: Add or remove groups and tags without replacing other memberships.
fleetManagement.maintenanceHelp: Monitoring continues. Health and connection alerts are suppressed during the window.
fleetManagement.windowInvalid: Choose a valid start and an end after the start.
fleetManagement.pauseHelp: Collection stops after the agent acknowledges the change. Heartbeats and agent updates continue.
fleetManagement.resumeHelp: Collection resumes after the agent receives the change. Fresh readings establish current health.
fleetManagement.upgradeRequired: Update this agent before pausing monitoring.
fleetManagement.pendingAck: Waiting for the agent to acknowledge.
fleetManagement.removeHelp: Choose what happens to the selected servers and their stored data.
fleetManagement.archiveHelp: Revoke the agent and archive the server. Restore it later to continue the same history.
fleetManagement.deleteHelp: Permanently delete this server and all its stored data. A new enrollment starts a new history.
fleetManagement.retentionReminder: Kept data follows your {days}-day retention policy.
fleetManagement.deleteConfirm: I understand that deleting stored data cannot be undone.
fleetManagement.previewChanged: The server selection or retention policy changed. Refresh and review removal again.
fleetManagement.setupHelp: Create a setup code, then use it on the server. Codes expire and can be used once.
fleetManagement.restoreHelp: Reconnect this archived identity with a new setup code. Its retained history and settings stay together.
fleetManagement.replaceHelp: Use a new setup code to reconnect this server. The existing agent credential will be revoked when it is used.
fleetManagement.setupLost: This code was already issued and cannot be shown again. Cancel it in Setup codes and create a new one.
fleetManagement.emptyHelp: Try another group or filter, or add a server.
fleetManagement.readOnly: Only Admins can change Fleet settings.
fleetManagement.selectionChanged: The selection changed. Choose the servers again.

dataSettings.title: Data
dataSettings.help: Choose how long monitoring readings and history stay available.
dataSettings.range: Keep monitoring data for 1–3650 whole days. The default is 90.
dataSettings.reduceHelp: Older monitoring data becomes unavailable as soon as this setting is saved. Cleanup then removes it in the background.
dataSettings.reduceSummary: Keep {days} days. Readings before {date} will expire.
dataSettings.irreversible: Increasing retention later does not bring expired data back.
dataSettings.scope: This applies to active, paused and archived servers. Server settings and identity are kept.
dataSettings.backup: Database backups follow your separate backup policy.
